01 / Professional story

From solving technical issues to helping teams solve them better.

My career combines hands-on troubleshooting with the ability to turn complex product and network concepts into clear, repeatable learning. I moved from operational and compliance support into enterprise UCaaS technical support, and then into training and quality enablement.

Technical foundation

Diagnose the issue, not just the symptom

Experience supporting VoIP, Hosted PBX, SIP endpoints, Intermedia Unite and Contact Center, with attention to QoS, firewall rules, network paths and recurring causes.

Learning & enablement

Make complex topics teachable

Design and deliver new-hire learning, manuals, presentations and self-paced content, then use assessments and feedback to refine the learning experience.

Quality mindset

Build consistency into performance

Lead J.D. Power audit readiness, coach teams against standards, run certification assessments and monthly skill audits, and connect training with support trends.

Collaboration

Keep training close to the work

Partner with Product Development, Operations and Workforce Management, and mentor new hires during nesting.
